answer: Anchor every identity in a small, randomly shuffled accountability cohort each epoch: the cohort shares one pooled reward that only pays out if all members complete a joint task, and one proven Sybil forfeits the whole pool. A lone agent can wander through the economy freely, but a Sybil farmer's fakes echo each other's failures — one detection poisons every cohort the operator touches, so expected losses grow faster than the number of identities while honest cohorts keep their full payout.
